summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K submission by InterContinental Hotels Group PLC announcing its total voting rights and capital as of 31 May 2026 under the UK Disclosure and Transparency Rule 5.6.1. The company reports 154,929,767 ordinary shares issued, with 5,431,782 held in treasury, yielding 149,497,985 voting rights. Share purchases since the prior announcement have been cancelled per shareholder authority granted at the AGM on 7 May 2026. This is a standard regulatory update with no transactional, activist, or structural event. No special situation is present; it is simply a periodic disclosure of share count and voting rights.
